text: Software engineering is an engineering discipline that focuses on the design, development, testing, maintenance, and management of software systems. Its core lies in using systematic, standardized, and quantifiable methods to address the complexity of large-scale software, ensuring that the software meets the expected goals in terms of efficiency, reliability, and security. It is not only a "down-to-earth tool" for computer science theories but also a core discipline that supports the transformation of digital products (such as apps, operating systems, industrial software) from concept to realization.
